Slice 3 landed on origin/main (bundle v2; unassessed unit at the floor in the cost model, owner decision 2026-11-10). Item 1 of this ticket is implemented as decided, with caveats from the cold review that need an OWNER DECISION before any path feeds supplied units to a cost model:
 a. Five named external states tied at the floor give an unassessed unit about 1.46x the external mass of an assessed unit at tau=1 (sum-product), and Viterbi picks one by key order: an arbitrary confident label. Candidate: one "external, kind not assessed" state priced to match an assessed unit's external mass (new vocabulary; ADR).
 b. Granularity 0.0 for an unassessed unit is recorded as a present perfect match, not as missing (contentcost.scala). The file's convention for unknown is 0.5; or report the term missing.
New follow-ups from the slice 3 reviews (none score-changing):
 9. Python study_bundle.check requires units numbered 1..n; StudyExport.parseSession requires only distinct numbers. Enforce 1..n in parseSession or relax Python.
10. Python: a stated number over ~4,300 digits raises an uncaught ValueError; a written judgement scene:true equals 1; a failed row's reason is not compared with the record.
11. Scala decode compares u by circe Json equality, which may accept 1.0 for 1 (unverified).
12. Bundles are ~4.7 MB each because each record repeats inventory and source nodes.
13. ff_score refuses bundles of a time condition until slice 4; the pinned synthetic bundle cannot pass check_bundle_judgements with the real film set (its film 2 is a non-target numbered 1-10).
14. agentStudyBundle writes are not atomic.
